meta.name: caveman-review
meta.description: Compressed code review - one line per finding with location, problem and fix. Use for /caveman-review, "review this PR", or "review the diff".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码审查压缩成逐条问题清单
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要快速review合并请求。
copy.tagline_en: Review code changes with one-line findings per issue.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently review pull requests and want compressed feedback.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把代码审查压成一行一条:位置、问题、修法,并直接给出可粘贴进 PR 的评论。可选用 bug、risk、nit 等严重度前缀,也能带文件名与行号范围。
howto.when: 当你输入 /caveman-review,或说“review this PR”“review the diff”时触发。

say.text: 用 caveman-review 审一下这个 PR
say.note: 输出一行一条、可直接粘贴的评论

say.text: review 这个 diff,每行一个问题加修法
继续审,把安全问题展开成完整说明
say.note: 安全类问题会切回完整叙述

howto.what_en: Claude turns code review into one line per finding: location, problem, fix, with output ready to paste into the PR. Optional bug/risk/nit severity prefixes, plus file and line ranges.
howto.when_en: Triggers on /caveman-review, or when you say "review this PR" or "review the diff".

say_en.note: One terse line per finding, ready to paste

say_en.text: Review this diff, one line per issue with a fix
Keep reviewing, expand the security finding
